_comment: Argus v0.1.10 expert-annotation input. Optional. Drop into assets/expert-annotations.json (without `.example`) to activate. Schema is loose - add fields as needed; Stage 1 reads what's present and ignores unknown keys. Every annotation MUST include human-written reasoning, not just a claim.

safe_patterns.description: Pyth pull-oracle reads in src/oracle/pyth_reader.rs with our own 60s heartbeat threshold. Do NOT flag staleness as a bug.
safe_patterns.reasoning: We verified the heartbeat constant is 60 (oracle/pyth_reader.rs:42), the deviation threshold is 0.5% (oracle/pyth_reader.rs:51), and both are gated behind a 24h timelocked admin path. Staleness scenarios were modeled in our own off-chain monitoring.

safe_patterns.description: All token mints in scope are canonical SPL Token (no Token-2022 extensions). Do NOT flag transfer-fee, transfer-hook, or mint-decimals-mutability concerns.
safe_patterns.applies_to: any reference to SPL Token CPI
safe_patterns.reasoning: Mint allowlist enforced at protocol initialization (initialize.rs:88-95) restricts to a hardcoded set of canonical SPL Token mints. Token-2022 extensions are not reachable.

trusted_invariants.claim: validator_set is updated atomically with merkle root in the same tx
trusted_invariants.reasoning: Verified manually 2026-04-15 by [reviewer]; the update path uses a single instruction with both writes. Do not flag race condition between validator set rotation and merkle root update.

trusted_invariants.claim: PDA seeds for vault accounts always include user_pubkey + vault_id
trusted_invariants.reasoning: Anchor `seeds = [b"vault", user.key().as_ref(), &vault_id.to_le_bytes()]` and bump-derivation enforced. Account substitution between users is impossible.

known_safe_call_patterns.reasoning: Already enforced upstream by the admin-router contract at <repo>/admin_router/src/lib.rs:42. Findings about missing admin check downstream are FPs.

scope_clarifications.status: deprecated, no funds in flight, kept for historical reads only
scope_clarifications.reasoning: Confirmed via on-chain query that all v1 vaults closed by 2026-02-01. Findings here have severity ≤ Informational regardless of mechanism.

_usage_notes: Stage 1 reads this file at run start IF present.
Annotations are injected into ALL Stage 2 angle prompts as: 'SAFE_PATTERNS - do not flag findings matching these UNLESS the annotation itself appears wrong.'

An angle that produces a finding matching a safe_patterns entry MUST output a `safe_pattern_override` field in the FINDING block justifying why the annotation is wrong. Otherwise the finding is suppressed at Stage 2 dedup.
Stage 4 ignores expert annotations - they are Stage 2 input only. Stage 4's job is independent adversarial review, not annotation enforcement.
If you delete this file, Argus runs without expert input - default behavior.
